How many pages does a government form run on average?
SELECT avg(pages) AS average FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE pages > 0
Which cities are served by the most separate water systems?

SELECT concat(city_served, ', ', state_served), count(DISTINCT pwsid) AS systems FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_geographic_areas WHERE city_served IS NOT NULL AND concat(city_served, ', ', state_served) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was ERCOT's peak hourly electricity demand in 2023?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id = 'EBA.ERCO-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '2023%'
How are NRC event notifications classed by emergency level?
SELECT emergency_class, count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do insiders hold the shares they trade directly or through trusts and other entities?

SELECT CASE direct_indirect_ownership WHEN 'D' THEN 'direct' WHEN 'I' THEN 'indirect' ELSE 'not stated' END AS ownership, count(*) AS transactions, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In which languages does ChEBI give the most international nonproprietary names?
SELECT language_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_names WHERE type = 'INN' AND language_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the highest system-wide hourly load in ERCOT's weather-zone forecasts?
Ercot Load Forecast By Weather Zone Cdr Lfcweathernp
SELECT max(try_cast(systemtotal AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.ercot_load_forecast_by_weather_zone_cdr_lfcweathernp
At which companies did insiders put the most money into their own stock in 2020?

SELECT s.issuername, sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double) * try_cast(t.trans_pricepershare AS double)) AS dollars_bought FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s ON s.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'P' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many materials does the Materials Project rate as thermodynamically stable?
SELECT count(*) AS stable FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_stable AS varchar) = 'true'
Which therapeutic areas draw the most industry research payments?

SELECT product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_research WHERE product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 <> '' AND product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the fair market rent for a two-bedroom home in Albany County, New York?

SELECT areaname, county_town_name, try_cast(fmr2 AS double) AS two_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'NY' AND countyname = 'Albany County' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies hold the most approved drug products?
SELECT applicant_full_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE applicant_full_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do companies pay doctors more in cash or in kind? (2023)

SELECT form_of_payment_or_transfer_of_value, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were the largest withdrawals from the Treasury's cash account over fiscal 2024?

SELECT transaction_catg, try_cast(transaction_fytd_amt AS double) AS millions FROM govblock_treasury.deposits_withdrawals_operating_cash WHERE record_date = '2024-09-30' AND transaction_type = 'Withdrawals' AND transaction_catg NOT LIKE '%Total%' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What share of the Southwest Power Pool's electricity came from wind in 2023?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double))) / sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw AS double)), 1) AS wind_pct FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'SWPP' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which industries do prime awards that pass work to sub-awardees come from most often?
SELECT naics_description, count(*) AS subawards FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE naics_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of recorded solar installations change from 2012 to 2022?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which arXiv subjects saw the most papers revised four or more times?
SELECT primary_category, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE try_cast(substr(latest_version, 2) AS integer) >= 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many links between candidates and their committees has the FEC recorded?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.candidate_committee_linkages
Which physician services cost Medicare the most nationwide in 2019?
Medicare Physician Other Practitioners By Geography And Service

SELECT hcpcs_desc AS service, round(sum(try_cast(tot_srvcs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS medicare_paid FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file LIKE '%D19_Geo%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many atoms does the largest QM9 molecule contain?
SELECT max(natoms) AS highest FROM govblock_chemistry.qm9_molecules
Under which statutes are patent cases most often brought?
SELECT case_cause, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many working residents did Puerto Rico have in 2007?
SELECT sum(c000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'pr' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2007
Which organisms are tested in the most ChEMBL assays?
SELECT assay_organism, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_assays WHERE assay_organism IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many skilled nursing facility cost reports were filed for fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_snf10_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '2025'
Which states have the most clinicians opted out of Medicare?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE state_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the personal saving rate in April 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS saving_rate FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadatam WHERE seriescode = 'A072RC' AND period = '2020M04'
At which hours of the day does Texas solar output peak, on average?
Ercot Hourly Solar Report Cdr Pvgrhrlyavgactnp
SELECT hour_ending, round(avg(try_cast(system_wide_gen AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.ercot_hourly_solar_report_cdr_pvgrhrlyavgactnp GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT chamber, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE state_file LIKE 'tx-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which large cities have the highest adult obesity rate?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS city, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_place WHERE measureid = 'OBESITY' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND try_cast(totalpopulation AS double) >= 500000 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How much in import duties did the United States collect on goods arriving in 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(cal_dut_mo AS double)) AS duties FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl WHERE year = '2024'
Which states saw the most home loans made in 2022?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS loans FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average three-bedroom fair market rent across Florida's counties?
SELECT avg(try_cast(fmr3 AS double)) AS avg_three_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'FL'
Which incorporated cities and towns cover the most land?
SELECT name, usps AS state, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_place WHERE funcstat = 'A' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT substr(cast(registration_dt AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS registrations FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE registration_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
How are hospitals filing fiscal 2023 cost reports owned: nonprofit, for-profit or government?

SELECT CASE WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('1', '2') THEN 'Nonprofit' WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('3', '4', '5', '6') THEN 'For-profit' ELSE 'Government' END AS ownership, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_rpt WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average rotor diameter of wind turbines built in 2022?
SELECT avg(try_cast(t_rd AS double)) AS avg_rotor_diameter_m FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(p_year AS varchar) = '2022'

SELECT auditee_name, try_cast(total_amount_expended AS double) AS expended FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many new papers were posted to arXiv each year from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) AS year, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states have the most active Davis-Bacon wage determinations?
SELECT states, count(DISTINCT wd_number) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'dbra' AND is_active = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the peak hourly electricity demand on California's grid on March 18, 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id = 'EBA.CISO-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '20220318%'

SELECT substr(recalldate, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.cpsc_recalls WHERE substr(recalldate, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2023') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which diseases have the most drugs approved or in clinical trials?

How many chemistry preprints were posted to ChemRxiv each year?
SELECT substr(posted_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS preprints FROM govblock_scholarly.chemrxiv_items GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
How are judges' recorded party affiliations split?

SELECT CASE political_party WHEN 'd' THEN 'Democratic' WHEN 'r' THEN 'Republican' WHEN 'i' THEN 'Independent' WHEN 'f' THEN 'Federalist' WHEN 'w' THEN 'Whig' ELSE political_party END AS party, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS judges FROM govblock_courts.people_db_political_affiliations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many applications build on a provisional application filed earlier?
SELECT count(DISTINCT application_number) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_continuity_parents_25 WHERE continuation_type = 'PRO'
In which countries is Energy Department-funded research most often published?
SELECT country_publication, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_research.osti_records WHERE country_publication <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many granted patents contributed reactions to the reaction set?
SELECT count(DISTINCT patentnumber) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants
Whose research is cited most, institution by institution?
SELECT display_name, country_code, try_cast(cited_by_count AS double) AS citations FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_institutions ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN study_type = 'OBSERVATIONAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_health.ct_studies
Which papers are cited most often by other papers in PubMed?
SELECT ref_pmid, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_health.pubmed_references WHERE ref_pmid <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications WHERE emergency_class IN ('ALERT', 'SITE AREA EMERGENCY', 'GENERAL EMERGENCY')

SELECT org_name, round(sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double))) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' AND org_state = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE maketxt = 'JEEP' AND modeltxt = 'GRAND CHEROKEE' AND cast(yeartxt AS varchar) = '2014' AND fire = 'Y'
Which lines of cover draw the most complaints in Texas, from homeowners to auto?
SELECT coverage_level, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_insurance_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2reactome

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_income FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b19013' AND a.variable = 'B19013_E001' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10

Which parent companies have the most affiliates registered as federal award recipients?
SELECT parent_legal_business_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE parent_legal_business_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many fewer mortgage applications were there in 2010 than in 2007?
SELECT as_of_year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar_2007_2017 WHERE cast(as_of_year AS varchar) IN ('2007', '2010') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which cities of 100,000 or more have lost the most residents since 2020?

SELECT name, stname, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) - try_cast(estimatesbase2020 AS double) AS change FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' AND try_cast(estimatesbase2020 AS double) >= 100000 ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT substr(column07, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS granted FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_uls_l_hd WHERE uls_file = 'l_cell.zip' AND substr(column07, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which words have been registered as trademarks by the most different applicants?
SELECT mark_id_char AS mark, count(*) AS registrations FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE registration_dt IS NOT NULL AND mark_id_char <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN upper(recipient_parent_name) LIKE 'LOCKHEED MARTIN%' THEN 'Lockheed Martin' ELSE 'Boeing' END AS company, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND (upper(recipient_parent_name) LIKE 'LOCKHEED MARTIN%' OR upper(recipient_parent_name) LIKE '%BOEING%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(npopchg2024 AS double) AS change FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT title, date FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND lower(title) LIKE '%medicare%' ORDER BY date LIMIT 5

SELECT plant_name, state, min(try_cast(operating_year AS integer)) AS oldest_unit FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE status = 'OP' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_state = 'NY' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2022'

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.PRICE.%-ALL.A' AND length(series_id) = 19 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Manhattan' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE '%newborn%' AND cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016'
Which states are home to the most federal award recipients?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT substr(start_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS studies FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE phases LIKE '%PHASE3%' AND substr(start_date, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10

SELECT comm_desc, sum(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_comm WHERE year = '2024' AND month = '12' AND comm_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Scorecard Most Recent Field Of Study

SELECT awarding_toptier_agency_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND awarding_toptier_agency_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS megawatts_out FROM govblock_energy.eia_nuc_status_data WHERE series_id = 'NUC_STATUS.OUT.US.D' AND period LIKE '2024%'

SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(density AS double) AS density_g_cm3 FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'Texas' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022'

SELECT name AS particle, count(*) AS appearances FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgdecay WHERE is_outgoing = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT areaname, try_cast(fmr0 AS double) AS studio, try_cast(fmr4 AS double) AS four_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE countyname = 'Los Angeles County' LIMIT 5
Which companies held the most total assets at the end of fiscal 2021?

SELECT s.name, max(n.value) AS total_assets FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_num n JOIN govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub s ON s.adsh = n.adsh WHERE n.tag = 'Assets' AND cast(n.qtrs AS varchar) = '0' AND s.form = '10-K' AND cast(s.fy AS varchar) = '2021' AND n.uom = 'USD' AND (n.segments IS NULL OR n.segments = '') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of trademark applications are filed before the mark is in use, on an intent-to-use basis?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(cast(lb_itu_file_in AS varchar) = '1') / count(*), 1) AS pct_intent_to_use FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file
Which contaminants are behind the most drinking water violations?

SELECT r.value_description, count(DISTINCT v.violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement AS v JOIN govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_ref_code_values AS r ON r.value_code = v.contaminant_code AND r.value_type LIKE 'CONTAMINANT%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of reactions found in granted patents change from 1980 to 2015?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('1980', '2015') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which industry sectors paid the highest average wages nationwide in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.industry_title, try_cast(q.avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_industry_titles AS t ON t.industry_code = q.industry_code WHERE q.area_fips = 'US000' AND q.agglvl_code = '14' AND q.own_code = '5' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What was the Henry Hub natural gas spot price on February 17, 2021?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_mmbtu FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.RNGWHHD.D' AND period = '20210217'
Which insurers file the most property and casualty rate changes in Texas?
SELECT company_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_property_casualty_rate_filings WHERE company_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal facilities reported toxic releases in 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND _21_federal_facility = 'YES'
Which states have the most clinicians profiled in Open Payments?
SELECT covered_recipient_profile_state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.op_covered_recipient_profile WHERE covered_recipient_profile_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many economically significant rules were on the fall 2024 regulatory agenda?
SELECT count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE cast(publication_id AS varchar) = '202410' AND priority_category LIKE 'Economically Significant%'
What kinds of transaction do company insiders report most often?

SELECT CASE trans_code WHEN 'P' THEN 'open-market purchase' WHEN 'S' THEN 'open-market sale' WHEN 'A' THEN 'grant or award' WHEN 'M' THEN 'option exercise' WHEN 'F' THEN 'shares withheld for tax' WHEN 'G' THEN 'gift' WHEN 'D' THEN 'sale back to the company' WHEN 'C' THEN 'conversion' WHEN 'J' THEN 'other' ELSE trans_code END AS kind, count(*) AS transactions FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of mortgage applications were denied for each race of applicant in 2023?

SELECT derived_race, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS pct_denied FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which cities have added the most people since 2020?

SELECT name, stname, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) - try_cast(estimatesbase2020 AS double) AS gain FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What exchange rate did the Treasury set for the euro at the end of 2024?
SELECT try_cast(exchange_rate AS double) AS euros_per_dollar FROM govblock_treasury.rates_of_exchange WHERE country_currency_desc = 'Euro Zone-Euro' AND record_date = '2024-12-31'
At what stage were the rules on the fall 2024 regulatory agenda?
SELECT rule_stage, count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE cast(publication_id AS varchar) = '202410' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which patents granted in 2022 had the most claims?
SELECT patent_id, patent_title, num_claims FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE patent_date LIKE '2022%' ORDER BY try_cast(num_claims AS integer) DESC LIMIT 10
Which metro areas have the largest Hispanic populations?

SELECT name, try_cast(tot_pop AS double) - try_cast(nh_male AS double) - try_cast(nh_female AS double) AS hispanic FROM govblock_census.popest_cbsa_est_alldata_char WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '7' AND try_cast(agegrp AS integer) = 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much debt had the Black Lung Disability Trust Fund built up by the end of fiscal 2024?
Black Lung Disability Trust Fund Results

SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS cumulative_debt FROM govblock_treasury.black_lung_disability_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc = 'Cumulative debt, end of year'
Which kinds of cross-reference does ChEBI record most often?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_database_accession WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did Defense Department contract obligations change from fiscal 2015 to fiscal 2024?

SELECT cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) AS year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE upper(awarding_agency_name) = 'DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE' AND cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) IN ('2015', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which grids imported the most electricity from their neighbours in 2023?

SELECT balancing_authority, round(-sum(try_cast(total_interchange_mw AS double))) AS net_imports_mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of the water sources used by public systems are surface water?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN water_type_code = 'SW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_facilities WHERE is_source_ind = 'Y'
Which industries had the most women-owned small business set-asides posted on SAM.gov?
SELECT naicscode, count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities WHERE setaside LIKE '%Women%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemical entities take part in Rhea reactions?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_chebiid_name
Which universities received the most NIH funding in fiscal year 2024?
SELECT org_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many write-in votes were counted for president in California in 2024?

SELECT sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'CALIFORNIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND writein = 'TRUE' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024'
What makes of vehicle were the drivers killed in 2022 crashes driving?
SELECT makename, count(*) AS drivers_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '1' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What net patient revenue did hospitals report in total for fiscal 2023?

SELECT sum(try_cast(itm_val_num AS double)) AS net_patient_revenue FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc WHERE wksht_cd = 'G300000' AND line_num = '00300' AND clmn_num = '00100' AND cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which courts appear most often in judges' job histories?
SELECT organization_name, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE coalesce(organization_name, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Rhea reactions have been retired as obsolete?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_obsoletes
Which congressional districts are the most compact in land area?
SELECT usps || '-' || substr(geoid, 3, 2) AS district, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_120cds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many federally qualified health centers filed cost reports for fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_fqhc14_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which states have the most units in subsidized housing projects?
SELECT substr(states, 4) AS state, sum(try_cast(total_units AS double)) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE try_cast(total_units AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did residential customers pay for natural gas per thousand cubic feet in January 2023?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_mcf FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.N3010US3.M' AND period = '202301'
Which departments had the largest net outlays in fiscal 2024?

SELECT replace(classification_desc, 'Total--', '') AS department, try_cast(current_fytd_net_outly_amt AS double) AS net_outlays FROM govblock_treasury.mts_table_5 WHERE record_date = '2024-09-30' AND classification_desc LIKE 'Total--%' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many trademark registrations were cancelled during 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(reg_cancel_dt AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
Which New York generators earned the highest average day-ahead price in July 2025?
Nyiso Lmp Day Ahead Hourly Mlbmp Gen

SELECT name, avg(try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double)) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_day_ahead_hourly_mlbmp_gen WHERE time_stamp LIKE '07/%/2025%' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many put options on the iShares 20+ Year Treasury fund appear in 13F filings?
SELECT count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable WHERE nameofissuer = 'ISHARES TR' AND titleofclass LIKE 'BARCLYS 20+%' AND putcall = 'Put'
What kinds of local education agency are there, and how many of each?
SELECT lea_type_text, count(*) AS districts FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_029 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
